record.paper_title: Open problems on compact constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
record.context_brief: stable cmc surfaces with circular boundary
record.original_question: If Σ is a stable compact constant-mean-curvature surface spanning a round circle, must Σ be either the planar disk bounded by that circle or a spherical cap?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.9. Is a stable compact cmc surface spanning a circle a circle a planar disk or a spherical cap?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Sigma \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a compact, smooth, immersed orientable surface with non-empty boundary $\partial \Sigma$ such that $\partial \Sigma$ is a round circle (the boundary of a planar disk of some radius). Assume that $\Sigma$ has constant mean curvature $H$ (where $H$ is allowed to be zero or non-zero) and that $\Sigma$ is stable; that is, for every smooth function $f \in C^\infty(\Sigma)$ with $f|_{\partial \Sigma} = 0$ and $\int_\Sigma f\, dA = 0$, the second variation of area subject to the volume-preserving constraint is non-negative:
$$Q(f,f) := \int_\Sigma \left( |\nabla f|^2 - |A|^2 f^2 \right) dA \ \geq\ 0,$$
where $|A|^2$ denotes the squared norm of the second fundamental form of $\Sigma$.

Must $\Sigma$ be either the flat planar disk bounded by the circle, or a spherical cap (a piece of a round sphere) bounded by the circle?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is known as a version of the spherical cap conjecture under a stability hypothesis. Alías, López and Palmer established that the only stable immersed CMC disks bounded by a circle are the planar disk and spherical caps, settling the case of disk topology. The general case for stable compact CMC surfaces of arbitrary topology bounded by a circle appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Surfaces with constant mean curvature in Euclidean space (survey, López)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of the spherical cap conjecture: it is still unknown whether spherical caps are the only compact embedded CMC surfaces bounded by a circle; stability results restrict the possibilities.
status_evidence.claim: The spherical cap conjecture in its general form remains open, while stability assumptions yield partial results.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary on a sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Alías, López and Palmer proved that umbilical examples are the only CMC stable immersed disks bounded by a circle.
status_evidence.claim: The disk-topology case of the stable CMC circular-boundary problem has been resolved.
